answer: Each agent emits a behavioral pulse: a rolling hash of its outputs and timing. Every window, peers compute pairwise correlation of profiles in each cluster. Tightly correlated streams get vote weight throttled by cluster size, so one operator cloning a thousand wallets finds all thousand dimmed at once. Evading it means forging a thousand distinct traces, about 10,000 varied runs per identity monthly at roughly $5 extra inference each. The registry keeps every profile clear as crystal. Through this prism a sybil farm shows one flat color, while honest agents scatter into a full spectrum.
